//: This config is what the CRE compiler typechecks with before it builds main.ts to WASM, so its
`include` is a statement about WHAT THE WORKFLOW IS, not about what this directory contains.
`*.ts` swept in main.test.ts, and the build failed on `Cannot find module 'bun:test'` — an error
about the test runner, raised against the workflow, at deploy time. The test is not part of the
workflow: it never ships to the enclave, and the types it needs are supplied by `bun test` at
run time rather than by this compilation.
So the workflow build compiles the workflow. tsconfig.test.json typechecks the test.
